name: oml
description: Remember and recall through an Open Memory Lab server over MCP. Writes are held until a different identity ratifies them.

url.title: OML server URL
url.description: Your Open Memory Lab server, without /mcp, as its sign-up page or administrator gave it to you.

api_key.title: Agent key
api_key.description: This agent's own OML key, never an admin key. Stored in the system keychain.

chat_workspace.title: Chat workspace
chat_workspace.description: Your chat workspace's id, as oml chat init prints it. Chat capture needs it; per-turn recall without it reads only the key's default workspace.
